reasoning: The landscape plan shows proposed mitigation trees (marked 'M') planted along the southern boundary of the site, directly adjacent to the overhead electric line marked '-OHE-'. According to UCM § 1.10.10.4, non-utility-compatible trees must be at least 15 lateral feet from distribution conductors, and utility-compatible trees must be 15-25 feet from distribution (for mature height <40 ft) or >25 feet (for all trees). Since voltage is not specified on the plans, this appears to be distribution infrastructure (typical for residential development). I need to measure distances from the tree trunk centers (planting locations) to the outside conductors of the overhead line to verify clearance compliance for each proposed tree in this area.
